metadata.algorithm: ordered FP32 all-product panel MLP small
metadata.training_order: fixed cyclic supplied-row order, no shuffle
metadata.tape: train pixels FP32 bits, train labels uint32, test pixels FP32 bits
metadata.gradient_lowering: stream gradient entries after all delta1 values computed; pre-update dependencies preserved
metadata.initialization: all scratch explicitly zeroed (charged); seeded initial weights set as raw FP32 literals
metadata.references: 4x4 lifetime/copy elimination; 16x16 asymmetric panels and persistent captures; repriced with v4 writes
metadata.arithmetic: Every output starts +0, ascending full K, separate mul/add, no partial sums or padding
metadata.lifetime: Shared panel/operand/acc buffers between products; xc between X@W1 and X.T@D1, then inference Q; d2 reused for inference scores
